laws.rule: Tourists who stay within the designated border-town zone for 24 hours pay no Sustainable Development Fee (SDF) from 2 June 2026, a waiver to be enforced for a year until August 2027. SDF applies to anyone who travels beyond Pinchinna checkpost. Guides are mandatory for land-border arrivals who travel beyond the border towns.
laws.heading: SDF waiver in border towns
